ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

2. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

9. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 29

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME

1. D — 10

2. C — 1, 2, 3, 6

3. D — 5
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

Working:
